passages.original: BENEDICTIO CEREI SANCTI AUGUSTINI EPISCOPI, CUM ADHUC DIACONUS ESSET, CECINIT, DICENS d.
passages.english: The blessing of the candle by Saint Augustine the bishop, which he sang while he was still a deacon, saying:
passages.notes: The final "d." appears to be a stray footnote mark or abbreviation from the printed edition and has been left untranslated. The Latin is loosely constructed: "BENEDICTIO ... CECINIT" lacks a relative pronoun (sense: "[which] he sang"). The candle (cereus) is presumably the Easter candle.
